blocks.p: Bunyan named the people of Mansoul for what they are, and most of the names still say it plainly: Lord Understanding, Mr. Conscience the Recorder, Captain Conviction, Mr. Godly-fear, Mr. False-peace. A few names in the story carry an older meaning the text explains the first time they appear: Shaddai (Almighty), Emmanuel (God with us), Diabolus (the Devil), Mansoul (a man’s soul), Captain Boanerges (sons of thunder), Captain Credence (faith), Captain Charity (love), the Lord Secretary (the King’s own Secretary, who knows his mind), the Election-doubters (who doubt God’s choosing), and the Perseverance-doubters. The names below have been changed because their meaning has worn away or reversed.
